summary: Documents extensions to RADIUS, already in use in network access server products, that let a server change a user's session while it runs. This includes disconnecting users and changing their authorizations. It replaces RFC 3576. It is informational because it describes deployed behavior rather than a standards-track design.

eli5.summary: Normally a guard checks you once at the door. This lets the guard later say, you must leave now, or you can now go to a different room.
